ADOPT into the row token
  • The standard 3-zone row, flat
  • Leading: STUDENT = circle avatar; CLASS = your pick (glyph / avatar)

  • Trailing: our banked status pill, OR value + chevron, OR an outline action-pill

  • Whole row taps to detail; a trailing pill is a distinct tap
SKIP (stays ours)

  • Their exact radii + tall row heights
  • Photo-thumbs where a subject glyph is calmer (your call)
